messages:
Evan (AE): Heads-up: NovaTrust wants a quick POC for SSO+provisioning. Requirements: SAML (IdP & SP), SCIM for users+groups, RBAC mapping, domain proofing for tenant-lock, and a Dedicated vs Private cost breakdown. Deadline: decision next Tue. Any immediate issues?

Rashmi (SE): On SAML: request their IdP metadata (XML or URL), preferred NameID (email vs persistent), and which attribute carries groups. Ask if they need signed+encrypted assertions. Also confirm if they want SP-initiated logout.

Ivan (Security): From the security intake: enforce SCIM over TLS1.2+, SCIM auth via OAuth2 client_credentials (scoped), token rotation every 90 days, and audit logs retained 180 days. Also want proof of SOC2 and key rotation policy.

Lydia (Eng): SCIM notes: we support full import + incremental/delta sync. Default rate-limit is 75 req/min; can be temporarily raised for POC on Dedicated. Nested groups are not flattened automatically  we can provide a helper script. For bulk onboarding we provide a secure CSV upload API (preserves externalId mapping). Example SCIM user we accept: ```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "maria@novatrust.com",
  "externalId": "nt-789"
}
```

Mark (Finance): For the quote I need estimated MAUs, peak tokens/month, and expected vGPU commit for Dedicated. Can we get rough numbers to draft a side-by-side?

Evan (AE): Customer estimate: 600 MAUs during POC, ~2.5M tokens/mo, initial groups ~800. They asked if tenant-lock supports multiple root domains.

Rashmi (SE): Tenant-lock: we issue per-domain TXT tokens. For org-level tenant lock across domains we accept multiple TXT proofs or an authority-signed email. We'll include the DNS TXT template in the docs.

ProvisionBot: scim-sync-connector/2026-02-01 deployed to staging  basic create/update tests passed \u2705

Ivan (Security): Potential blocker: NovaTrust indicates EU data residency requirement for identity data. If true, propose EU Dedicated or Private. Legal will need DPA + region addendum; lead time ~3 business days.

Lydia (Eng): Networking for Private: must allow outbound to control-plane on 443 and exchange mTLS certs. On-prem installer also needs a maintenance window for upgrades.

Mark (Finance): I'll draft a POC quote with a 30-day trial credit and a Dedicated vs Private comparison if you confirm MAU/token numbers by EOD today.

Rashmi (SE): Action: I'll request IdP metadata, a sample SAML response, and a sample SCIM payload from the customer. I'll prepare a short SAML+SCIM quickstart and an RBAC mapping CSV template.

Evan (AE): Thanks all  I'll confirm EU residency and schedule a 30-min call with NovaTrust for Fri 10am PT.

Ivan (Security): Also attach SOC2 attestation and a short note on least-privilege scopes for SCIM (scim:users.write scim:groups.write).
